audience: gym managers and front-desk staff who run their facility in Rock Gym Pro

useCases.title: See who is checked in right now
useCases.text: Count the customers checked in at the facility now. List the check-ins for a date-time range to see who came in.

useCases.title: Find a customer and open the record
useCases.text: Filter the customers of a facility by type, status, dates, name or email. Open one customer by its GUID to see the details.

useCases.title: Review the bookings for a class
useCases.text: List the bookings of the facility for a date-time range, or for one customer. Open one booking to see its details.

useCases.title: Check invoices and sales for a period
useCases.text: List the invoices of the facility for a date-time range and open one. Read the sales by product for the same period.

useCases.title: Read daily numbers and staff timeclock entries
useCases.text: Read the daily number figures of the facility for a date range. List the staff timeclock entries for the same period.
